# `/public-identities` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /public-identities/v1

`getPublicIdentitiesV1` — Get list of public identities

Get a list of public identities. Set `add-core-filters` to `true` to exclude incomplete identities and uncorrelated accounts.

- Scopes: sp:scopes:default
- User levels: USER
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; alias: eq, sw; email: eq, sw; firstname: eq, sw; lastname: eq, sw — e.g. `firstname eq "John"`
  - `add-core-filters` (query) — default False — If *true*, only get identities which satisfy ALL the following criteria in addition to any criteria specified by *filters*: - Should be either correlated or protected. - Should not be "spadmin" or…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name — e.g. `name`
- Returns 200: array of publicidentity

### GET /public-identities/v2/visible-attributes

`getPublicIdentitiesVisibleAttributesV2` — Get public identity visible attributes — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns the default and configured identity attribute keys (with display names) that are allowed for public-identity search and projection. Call this before POST /public-identities/v2/search to learn which field keys are valid in query fields and sort. Any authenticated user with the default scope can call this endpoint.

- Scopes: sp:scopes:default
- User levels: USER
- Returns 200: publicidentityvisibleattributes

### POST /public-identities/v2/search

`searchPublicIdentitiesV2` — Search public identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Search public identities using a composite query and return matching records. The root query set combines criteria with AND and must include attributes.identityState.exact = ACTIVE. The field keys must come from GET /public-identities/v2/visible-attributes and may use the prefix "attributes." and/or the suffix ".exact". See the request examples for the required exact payload structure. Any authenticated user with the default scope can call this endpoint.

- Scopes: sp:scopes:default
- User levels: USER
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.

  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Body (application/json): publicidentitiessearchrequest
- Returns 200: array of publicidentityv2
